items.description: Math.floor((score - 10) / 2) — the D&D ability modifier formula — appears in 6 files: CharacterInfoSection.tsx:33, DnDSkills.tsx:11, SavingThrowsDisplay.tsx:17, DnDSavingThrows.tsx:11, diceCalculations.ts:27, Phase1Demo.tsx:172. This is a rendering rule violation: the web is calculating game mechanics. The API should provide computed modifier values.

applyMonsterMovement at LobbyView.tsx:89 is a module-level function that transforms Room entity positions. It is not extracted in either PR #377 or PR #378 (only entityStateToPlacement, roomFromEncounterState, doorsFromEncounterState, monstersFromEncounterState were extracted). It belongs in utils/monsterTurnUtils.ts or similar.

src/concepts/class-selection/data.ts contains hardcoded class descriptions, ability score guidance, and level progression tables. If this concept is promoted, the data layer must be replaced with API calls — hardcoded game data in the web layer violates the rendering rules.

Both ActionPanel.tsx and ActionPanelV2.tsx exist and are exported from combat-v2/panels/index.ts. No documentation explains which supersedes the other or which LobbyView actually uses. Needs clarification and deprecation of one.

items.summary: OpenDoor reveal stores room-B walls and entities without translating from room-local to dungeon-absolute, so revealed rooms overlap room A geometrically

MovementCompletedEvent for players carries entityId+path but omits updatedEntity, so handleMovementCompleted in LobbyView never advanced the character position in encounterState. Fix mirrors applyMonsterMovement: fall back on path[path.length-1] via new mergeEntityPosition helper. Stream dispatch was already correct (useEncounterStream.ts:127). Branch fix/wave2-player-move-render, commit 0d82258. Awaiting Kirk playtest verification.
